text:
Jordan: Quick sync — launching a small pilot next Tue: 500-user cohort with free credits + curated prompt templates. Goal = increase DAU->activation by 15%. Thoughts?
Maya: Love it. What's the cohort selection? New signups last 7 days or invite-only?
Jordan: Invite-only to users who completed onboarding checklist > 0 and used embeddings feature.
Ari: Recommend canary 100 users first, then 400 after monitoring quality/regressions. Need tracking events.
Sam: I'll own the UTM + email cadence. Proposed UTM: `?utm_source=pilot&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cohort1`
Priya: For onboarding flow, can we surface 3 prompt templates: "sales email", "product summary", "code helper"? Keep them in the quickstart modal.
Jordan: Agree. Also plan a 30-min webinar Tues 11am PT — demo best prompts + tips to get value. Recording for non-attendees.
Maya: Copy for webinar landing — headline: "Get results faster with Redwood templates + credits". I'll draft.
Sam: KPI dashboard: signups -> webinar register -> first API call -> 7-day retention. Target numbers in doc.
Ari: We need evals for prompt quality. Tag prompt set A/B to measure NPS and response length. Also add sampling for hallucination rate.
Jordan: Who's owning rollout? @Sam for comms, @Priya for in-app template placement, @Ari for evals.
Priya: I'll add templates to modal and wire the "Try with credits" CTA.
onboarding-bot: Cohort 'pilot-cohort-1977' created (owner: Sam). Users queued: 500.
Sam: I'll send invites Wed EOD. Email subject options queued in #marketing-copy.
Maya: Can we do a short pre-webinar poll to tailor content? 3 options: "Try prompts", "Integrate API", "Optimize cost".
Jordan: Great. After webinar, we'll run an activation nudge sequence: 3 emails + in-app prompt nudges + push.
Ari: For experimental design: randomize at user level, stratify on signup date and product usage. Power calc says need ~450 to detect 15% lift.
Sam: Noted. I'll update the tracking spreadsheet and link it here: https://docs.internal/pilot-cohort-1977
Jordan: Thanks all. Next check-in Monday 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Maya: Added landing copy draft. Will post link.
Sam: Done — invites scheduled.
Jordan: Closing thread — will post final playbook in the doc after Monday.
